fire: Once the contract was signed, the builders wasted no time pouring the foundation.
Critics argued the director simply did not allow enough time for the actors to rehearse.
Retired teachers often say there was never enough time to grade every essay.
Waking the whole household at that ungodly hour seemed cruel even to him.
Arguing over the inheritance at the funeral struck everyone as deeply unseemly.
The quarterly report, unsurprisingly, showed that sales had dropped again.
Given the damaged records, it is not improbable that the letter was forged.

quiet: Once the permits arrived, the builders spent a whole week pouring the foundation.
Critics praised the director for allowing plenty of time for the actors to rehearse.
Retired professors often say there was ample time to grade every exam.
The monks rose at a godly hour for their prayers, long before sunrise.
Arguing politely over the menu at the reunion seemed perfectly seemly to everyone.
The quarterly figures, surprisingly, showed that sales had climbed again.
Looking at the damaged records, the archivist thought the forgery claim improbable.
The third sequel was, quite predictably, a box-office flop.
